meta.name: diffdock
meta.description: DiffDock and DiffDock-L molecular docking. Use for protein-small-molecule pose prediction from PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, batch docking, virtual screening, and pose-confidence interpretation. Not for binding affinity prediction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测药物分子怎样结合蛋白质
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在药物研发中需要判断化合物如何结合靶蛋白。
copy.tagline_en: Predict how drug molecules bind to proteins
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on drug discovery and need to see how small molecules bind to a target protein.

howto.what: 预测小分子配体与蛋白的 3D 结合构象，输出带置信度分数的多个候选构象；支持 PDB 或序列加 SMILES/SDF/MOL2 输入、批量对接与虚拟筛选。它不预测结合亲和力。
howto.when: 当你要求对接配体、预测结合构象、做虚拟筛选等任务，或给出 PDB 文件/蛋白序列加配体结构时接管。

say.text: 把这个 SMILES 配体对接到 protein.pdb，预测结合构象
say.note: 生成 rank1 等带置信度的 SDF 构象文件

say.text: 用 batch_input.csv 批量对接这些复合物，批大小设 10
say.note: 按 CSV 逐行执行对接

say.text: 分析 results/batch/ 的结果，列出每个复合物前 5 个预测
say.note: 按置信度排序并输出汇总

howto.what_en: Predicts 3D binding poses of small-molecule ligands to a protein and outputs multiple ranked poses with confidence scores; accepts PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, and supports batch docking and virtual screening. It does not predict binding affinity.
howto.when_en: Use when asked to dock a ligand, predict a binding pose, or run virtual screening, or when you provide a PDB file/sequence together with a ligand structure.

say_en.text: Dock this SMILES ligand into protein.pdb and predict its binding pose
say_en.note: Writes rank1 and other poses as confidence-labeled SDF files

say_en.text: Batch dock these complexes using batch_input.csv with batch size 10
say_en.note: Runs docking row by row from the CSV

say_en.text: Analyze results/batch/ and list the top 5 poses per complex
say_en.note: Ranks by confidence and writes a summary
